mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread telling other builders to measure King bearings before installing. Snippet reports King STDX thrust bearings measured over 1mm too narrow to fit the block.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on King main thrust bearings. Snippet describes a 2024 main bearing found out of spec on free spread and a second bad 2025 bearing, with the poster questioning the manufacturing process.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Defect report on King main bearings for BMW S85/S65 blocks, with the poster stating King STDX thrust bearings were over 1mm too narrow and concluding the brand cannot be trusted.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Defect report on a King SI set: one shell malformed in production, crushed and twisted and out of size, plus machining shavings and oil found in the shrink wrap.
